## Rule

**Generator ground truth** (`external/ARC-GEN/tasks/task_e26a3af2.py`): the clean image is 3–5
solid vertical stripe bands (each 2–6 columns wide, one color), built so `output[r][c]` depends
only on `c` (**every row identical**); `xpose` (50%) transposes both grids → horizontal bands
(**every column identical**). The INPUT is then corrupted by `random_pixels(prob=0.1)` — ~10% of
cells overwritten with random colors. The OUTPUT stays clean. **The task is denoising-to-bands, NOT
symmetry** (the "Symmetry Completion" class label is a misnomer for this generator — see formulation
verdict below).

Recovering the clean image = take the **per-line mode (dominant color)** along the axis where the
clean image is constant; the axis is unknown at inference (xpose hidden) so it is picked by
**confidence** = `sum(max_color_count_per_line)` (the clean axis has near-constant lines → high
confidence). Row confidence higher → paint each active row with its row dominant; else paint each
active column with its column dominant. Cells outside the active grid are all-zero padding.

Boundary fix: the scout's unique-dominant-count rule was only 262/266 official and 189,247/200,000 full corpus. The four official misses are vertical-band cases where `len(set(col_dominants)) == len(set(row_dominants))`; the unique-count fallback chooses noisy row dominants. Confidence resolves the tie and is 266/266 official + 200,000/200,000 corpus with ONNX ArgMax-low tie semantics.

## Algorithm sketch (CURRENT BEST = v16 factor-Where, cost 3499)

```python
col_cnts = input.sum(axis=2, keepdims=True)        # [1,10,1,30] F32 1200 B
row_cnts = input.sum(axis=3, keepdims=True)        # [1,10,30,1] F32 1200 B
col_max  = col_cnts.max(axis=1, keepdims=True)     # [1,1,1,30]
row_max  = row_cnts.max(axis=1, keepdims=True)     # [1,1,30,1]
pick_col = row_max.sum() <= col_max.sum()            # cols win ties

# signed threshold fold: chosen axis uses 31/32 * max; open axis uses -max.
# Strict Greater makes padding lines (max=0) false without a separate active gate.
factor_col = 31/32 if pick_col else -1
factor_row = -1 if pick_col else 31/32
X = col_cnts > col_max * factor_col                  # [1,10,1,30] BOOL 300 B
Y = row_cnts > row_max * factor_row                  # [1,10,30,1] BOOL 300 B
output = X & Y                                       # final output is free
```

v15 (team-best 3508) replaced v14's active-gated `GreaterOrEqual` chain with signed strict-Greater
thresholds, deleting the two active masks and two 300 B `And` stripes. v16 keeps that formulation
but uses scalar `Where` to choose the two factors directly, deleting `pick_col_f`, `gpc`, and one
scalar initializer for a strict 9-byte drop.

## Cost analysis

Superseded cost breakdowns (live 45132, boolmask 25694, v8 4510, v14 4158 contributors) are in `_archive/task359_history.md`. Current best v16 = **3499** (memory 3497 + params 2): col_cnts/row_cnts F32 histograms 1200 B each (2400), col_max/row_max F32 120 B each (240), thr_col/thr_row F32 120 B each (240), x_pat/y_pat skinny BOOL 300 B each (600), col_conf/row_conf 8, pick_col 1, factor_col/factor_row 8, and two scalar params. The final `[1,10,30,30]` BOOL `And` is the graph output and is not counted.

### Floor status — no absolute floor claim (2026-06-12)

The 2026-06-07 **formulation** result still holds: the generator is denoising stripe bands, not symmetry, and fresh-generator falsification showed per-line mode is the exact rule while geometry/single-line/mean-style alternatives fail. The input is corrupted noise, so a correct rule needs aggregation over the perpendicular axis.

The old **4,158 absolute cost floor is retracted**. Aditya's v15 signed-threshold graph (team manifest cost 3508) showed the active-line gates are not forced: strict `Greater(count, -max)` opens an active line while keeping padding false because padding has `max=0`. v16 only nibbles that scalar tail to 3499.

Remaining hard pressure in the current exact formulation: the two F32 histograms are locked at 2,400 B by the F32 input dtype; `col_max`/`row_max`, `thr_col`/`thr_row`, and the two 300 B skinny BOOL operands bring the non-scalar subtotal to 3,480 B before 17 B of scalar memory and 2 params. Further material savings require eliminating one of those retained 120/300 B tensors or finding a genuinely different exact non-histogram formulation. No such route was found in this pass.

Prior under-3k direct-output Conv probes remain unsafe learning artifacts: dense/grouped/depthwise visible-fit graphs pass officials but fail full generator truth badly (best recorded failures include 34,666/200,000, 49,516/200,000, 59,321/200,000, and ~18,904/50,000).

- 2026-05-19: Crop-to-active-grid does not help. Slice adds [1,10,H,W] intermediate plus output_small [1,10,H,W] intermediate (both 26000B at 25×26), totalling +52000B new cost vs saving only ~12000B. Net worse.

Unique-count plus switch tie-break is 266/266 official but still 199779/200000 corpus, so it is also not a deterministic solution.

- 2026-06-04: Shape-only orientation fails 24442/200000. Both dimensions are 13..15 in 49137/200000 generated pairs, and row/col axes are balanced inside those ambiguous shapes.
- 2026-06-04: Sparse sampled mode is not shippable below exact histogram: 3/5/7 orthogonal samples fail selected-axis color recovery on 45350/4115/282 corpus pairs. All first 13 orthogonal samples recover colors exactly, but implementing that as a counted histogram keeps the same per-axis output shape.
- 2026-06-04: Numeric summaries do not replace histograms: average/round/floor/ceil fail at least 186006/200000; median selected-axis colors still fail 44/200000 and median-derived axis pick is much worse.
- 2026-06-04: Raw `Equal(counts,max)` dominant masks are invalid without active-line gating: padding lines have `counts == max == 0` for all 10 colors. The post-branch active-gated repair is valid and staged, but still costs 4,510 after the v8 Cast-active parameter deletion.
- 2026-06-04: Replacing `Not(pick_row)` with `LessOrEqual(row_conf,col_conf)` is accepted but ties the v4/v5 cost before the post-branch active-gating rewrite; it does not recover the hoped-for scalar byte by itself.
- 2026-06-04: Single-node Conv under 3k is not a safe replacement. Visible-trained dense/grouped SVM Conv probes score 2,510→2,110 and can hit 266/266 visible, but fail full generator truth badly: dense v9 34,666/200,000, group2 7×7 v10 59,321/200,000, group2 6×7 v12 49,516/200,000. Training dense Conv on full generator samples does not fix it (SGD 73,370/200,000; balanced SVM 50,955/200,000). Keep these only as explicitly unsafe public-score probes.
- 2026-06-04: Conv-bias removal is not viable for the visible-fit grouped probes. No-intercept group2 6×7 and 5×9 models collapse to 0/266 visible before threshold tuning and remain useless after threshold tuning.
- 2026-06-04: Depthwise 6×22 lowers the unsafe visible-fit floor to 1,330, but smaller depthwise footprints did not close. 6×21 and 6×20 remain 265/266 after high-C and class-weight sweeps; 5×40/5×45 remain 260/266 or worse; depthwise no-intercept 6×22 collapses to 2/266 after threshold tuning. Do not treat this as a structural solution.
- 2026-06-07: **F16-input histogram halving is DEAD.** The histograms are F32 1,200 B each only because the input is F32. Declaring the model input FLOAT16 (so `ReduceSum` yields F16 600 B histograms) is impossible: `tools/ng_harness/session.py::run_raw` feeds `x.astype(np.float32)` for every gate, and ORT rejects a float32 feed into a float16 input. Inserting a `Cast(input->F16)` materializes an 18,000 B `[1,10,30,30]` intermediate — far worse. The 2,400 B histogram cost is a hard floor for this task.
- 2026-06-07 **[FORMULATION BREAK — geometry is dead]**: task359 is classified "Symmetry Completion" but is NOT a geometry task. Generator `task_e26a3af2.py` builds solid stripe bands and corrupts ~10% of input cells (noise), output = clean image. Falsified on 3000 fresh generator pairs: identity/flipH/flipV/transpose/rot180/any-mirror all **0/3000**; broadcasting a single noisy input line works only ~14%. Only per-line mode (histogram) is exact (3000/3000). Do NOT re-attempt mirror/overlay/tiling/reflection formulations; the input is corrupted, not partial.
- 2026-06-12: The old v14 4,158 tail floor is false. Signed strict-Greater thresholds (`count > -max` on the open axis, `count > 31/32*max` on the chosen axis) remove active gates and lower the exact family to 3,508/3,499. Further scalar rewrites using one factor plus `Neg`/`Sub` were priced worse or equal because saved params become charged scalar intermediates.
